Description
Elevate your lifestyle with this exceptional townhome situated in an exclusive, upscale neighbourhood. Immerse yourself in the serene beauty of an expansive rooftop deck, perfect for entertaining or simply savouring the picturesque vistas where breathtaking water, city, and mountain views await. Step into the private master suite offers a retreat-like ambiance with its spacious layout, walk-in closet, and lavish bathroom featuring a soaker tub and separate shower. Maple hardwood floors and stylish glass railings enhance the home's elegance, while the gourmet kitchen, equipped with high-end appliances, ensures a seamless culinary experience.

Description
Welcome to the Mackenzie Green, these low-rise Vancouver townhomes were built in 2012 by Pantheon Developments Ltd. The location and the neighbouring community of Mackenzie Heights is a top notch. Exclusive collection of boutique Townhomes features include Inform European custom cabinets, Wolf stainless gas range, Integrated appliances, wide-plank engineered walnut flooring, Quartzite countertops, overheight ceilings, frameless glass shower enclosures, contemporary bathrooms, and high-ceiling spacious bedrooms. The ground floor also has an exclusive outdoor patio and the indoor has an office den area and a in-suite storage. This home is perfect for a small family. 1 parking is included in the rent, utilities are not included. This home does not have AC.

Description
Make yourself at home in Vancouver's West End. This two-level townhouse pairs a garden patio and private rooftop terrace with a living room, gas fireplace and hardwood floors. Enjoy Robson Street shops and restaurants, Davie Village, and weekend plans at English Bay or Stanley Park. Approx. 1,192 sq. ft., 2 bedrooms, 2 full bathrooms plus a powder room, quartz kitchen counters, maple cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, gas range, dishwasher and in-suite laundry. $5,500/month; available December 1, 2026. Unfurnished; minimum one-year lease; utilities extra. One off-street parking space included; no storage. Pets considered case-by-case. Some photos digitally decluttered. Contact David Siccia, Licensed Property Manager, Heller Murch Realty, 236-998-5841. https://davidsicciaproperties.ca

Description
This stunning Kitsilano gem is an absolute must see! 4 bedrooms, 2.5 bathroom main level features a perfect layout for your family. Main floor contains a spacious living/dining area with cozy gas fireplace, natural hard wood flooring, large windows for plenty of natural light, clean neutral wall tones. A chef's dream of a kitchen! Plenty of storage within the wood cabinetry, large center island with stone countertops, stainless steel appliances, and surrounding windows. Primary and secondary bedrooms are located on the main level with one bathroom and a ensuite to the primary. Downstairs holds the third bedroom, full bathroom, private laundry, and a large 4th bedroom (no closet) /could also be used as a rec room/office/ kids play area- the options are endless!

Description
Welcome to The Waterford, a highly sought-after luxury tower in Yaletown, ideally located along the waterfront, seawall and David Lam Park. This high-floor 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom corner residence offers approximately 1,110 sq. ft. of spacious living with beautiful water, park and city views. The home features an expansive floor plan, oversized floor-to-ceiling windows, air conditioning, laminate flooring, gas fireplace, granite countertops, stainless steel gas appliances, dedicated dining area and generous living space. A west-facing solarium provides an ideal home office or flex space, while the beautifully appointed bathrooms feature soaker tubs. Residents enjoy Club Viva amenities including an approximately 80-ft indoor pool, fitness centre, sauna and steam room. Unit is UNFURNISHED.
